science.verdict: RW Aurigae: saturated in 39 % of frames; aperture photometry; pass 0 minus pass 2: D1 +0.37 +- 0.14, D6 -0.76 +- 0.03 mag (slope -0.34 +- 0.01 mag/micron); pass 1 minus pass 2: D1 +0.38 +- 0.06, D6 -0.33 +- 0.03 mag (slope -0.22 +- 0.02 mag/micron); control star rms 0.005 mag

notes: false = detections per usable frame outside the excluded radius around the target; positivePerFrame counts positive detections only.

falsePlain uses one purely statistical sigma for all three modes (no star-noise term and no model-error map for the template); falsePlainModelError (template only) is the earlier asymmetric number, statistical sigma plus the template's model-error map.
falsePairCalibration (template only) gives the template exactly the pairs' calibration: the fitted star-noise term without its model-error map.

snrWidth = robust width (1.4826 MAD) of the S/N outside the target mask on faint sky (static sky < 3 sigma), mid (3-10) and bright (> 10 sigma) pixels, classes defined on the chromatic template; 1.0 means a calibrated sigma. falseUnitMad = false detections after dividing each class of each mode's S/N by that width.
depth = median 1-sigma of the difference image in microJy per 6.15 arcsec pixel.
completeness: fraction of injected point sources recovered; 'all' counts frames without a result as misses, 'searchable' leaves them out.
